SELECT
    s.carrier,
    COUNT(*) AS total_shipments,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE s.status = 'delivered'
    ) AS delivered_shipments,
    ROUND(
        100.0
        * COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE s.status = 'delivered'
        )
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS delivery_success_rate_pct
FROM shipments AS s
GROUP BY s.carrier
ORDER BY delivery_success_rate_pct DESC, s.carrier;
